displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 视觉 · 大遮挡图像修复

displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists LaMa as row 6 in the Vision area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table and links it to “Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions”. The official Main Contributors prefix is Roman Suvorov followed by Victor Lempitsky, and the row's aggregate institution and country fields are preserved exactly.

The WACV 2022 paper identifies Suvorov with Samsung AI Center Moscow and as the correspondence contact, while Lempitsky is affiliated with Samsung AI Center Moscow and the Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology. LaMa combines fast Fourier convolutions, a high-receptive-field perceptual loss, and large training masks so the network can use global image context and generalize beyond its training resolution.
displayDescription.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表的“视觉”领域将 LaMa 列为第 6 项，并关联论文《Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions》。官方“主要人物”前缀依次为罗曼·苏沃洛夫和维克托·列姆皮茨基，机构与国家的聚合字段按官方原文完整保留。

WACV 2022 论文注明苏沃洛夫来自三星莫斯科 AI 中心并担任通讯联系人，列姆皮茨基来自三星莫斯科 AI 中心和斯科尔科沃科学技术学院。LaMa 结合快速傅里叶卷积、高感受野感知损失和大面积训练遮罩，使网络能够利用全图上下文，并泛化到高于训练分辨率的图像。

html.en: Before LaMa, modern image-inpainting systems still struggled when missing regions were large, structures were geometric or periodic, or test images exceeded the training resolution. The WACV 2022 paper framed insufficient effective receptive field in both the generator and the loss as a central cause, and BenchCouncil subsequently placed LaMa in row 6 of its 2022-2023 Vision selection.
html.zh: 在 LaMa 之前，现代图像修复系统面对大面积缺失、几何或周期结构，以及高于训练分辨率的测试图像时仍容易失效。WACV 2022 论文把生成器和损失函数的有效感受野不足视为核心原因，BenchCouncil 随后将 LaMa 列入 2022-2023 年度“视觉”领域第 6 项。

html.en: LaMa feeds a masked image and its binary mask to a ResNet-like generator whose fast Fourier convolution blocks split features into local and global paths. The global path transforms features into the frequency domain and back, while a high-receptive-field perceptual loss and large generated training masks encourage coherent full-image structure and resolution robustness.
html.zh: LaMa 将遮挡图像与二值遮罩输入一个类似 ResNet 的生成器，其中快速傅里叶卷积模块把特征分成局部分支和全局分支。全局分支把特征变换到频域后再还原，同时使用高感受野感知损失和大面积随机训练遮罩，促使结果保持全图结构一致并具备分辨率稳健性。

html.en: Experts generally treat LaMa as an important large-mask inpainting baseline because it coordinates receptive field design across the network, loss, and mask-generation strategy instead of relying only on a larger generator. Its open implementation and demonstrated ability to complete periodic structures and higher-resolution images made the method practical to reproduce and extend, while the BenchCouncil row documents its contemporary recognition rather than a permanent ranking.
html.zh: 专家通常把 LaMa 视为大遮挡图像修复的重要基线，因为它同时协调网络、损失函数和遮罩生成策略的感受野设计，而不是只扩大生成器。其开放实现以及对周期结构和更高分辨率图像的修复能力，使该方法便于复现和扩展；BenchCouncil 年度行记录的是当时的认可，而不是永久排名。
